title: Carrier Batch Allowances Booked for a Collection on Renew Business Asset Buyback
content:
The batch allowance the carrier books for a collection on a Renew Business Asset Buyback agreement is read from the agreement's own collection account and from the shipment requests already taken on it. The account is read as the freight charges raised on the agreement less the freight charges relieved on it by a waiver, rounded to the cent; that figure is what stands unsettled. The restricted balance against which it is measured is 60.00 USD.

| The agreement's collection account and its shipment requests | The batch allowance the carrier books |
| --- | --- |
| the freight charges raised on the agreement and not yet settled or waived stand above 60.00 USD, and a shipment request has already been taken on the agreement | 24 machines |
| those charges stand above 60.00 USD, and no shipment request has yet been taken on the agreement | 30 machines |
| no freight charge raised on the agreement stands unsettled above 60.00 USD | 40 machines |

**Both sides of the balance.** The comparison is a strict one: charges standing unsettled at exactly 60.00 USD are not above the restricted balance, and the carrier books 40 machines. Charges standing unsettled at 60.01 USD are above it, and the allowance is then 24 machines where a shipment request has already been taken on the agreement and 30 machines where none has.

**Both sides of the request count.** A shipment request has already been taken on the agreement where at least one such request stands on it; no shipment request has yet been taken where the agreement carries none at all. The distinction only bears on the allowance while the unsettled charges stand above 60.00 USD.

**Hypothetical illustrations.**

- Freight charges of 310.00 USD raised on the agreement and 310.00 USD relieved by a waiver leave nothing unsettled, so the allowance is 40 machines whatever the request count.
- Freight charges of 310.00 USD raised and 262.50 USD relieved leave 47.50 USD unsettled, which is not above 60.00 USD, so the allowance is again 40 machines.
- Freight charges of 310.00 USD raised and nothing relieved leave 310.00 USD unsettled, which is above 60.00 USD; with one shipment request already taken the allowance is 24 machines, and with none taken it is 30 machines.
